200.description:
Trade values, quantities and weights from the public preview of UN Comtrade (GET /public/v1/preview/{type}/{freq}/{classification}). One commodity code per call; the API accepts one period per request and silently caps each request at 500 records, so the function issues one request per requested period (up to 12, listed or as a range such as 2012-2019) and reports `truncated` per period. Partner omitted = breakdown by every partner; partner 0 = the reporter's world total. Values are USD as published (CIF for imports, FOB for exports); the full key-gated /data/v1 endpoint is not used.
